name: AppBanner
title: AppBanner
summary: Promotes the dot.Bible app in three sizes: a dismissible "Open in app" smart banner on mobile, an inline promo card with QR and store badges on desktop, and a slim strip at the end of an article.
whenToUse: Smart banner `.mn-sbanner`: top of mobile pages on dot.bible and ism.bible, once per visit.
Promo card `.mn-promo`: inside a page section about the app or Scripture access.
Slim strip `.mn-strip`: end of an article or reading page.
whenNotToUse: Do not stack more than one app promotion in a view.
Do not use for giving or newsletter asks; use DonationWidget or NewsletterCard.

anatomy.description: Every variant starts with the app tile `.mn-apptile`: the dot.Bible icon in white on black with a 3px `--gradient-line` underline. Smart banner (above the site header): Promo card: Slim strip:

props.name: variant
props.description:
`smartBanner` is the dismissible "Open in app" bar for the top of mobile pages, `promo` is the inline
card with QR and store badges for desktop, `strip` is the slim end-of-article strip.

props.name: iconSrc
props.description: URL of the dot.Bible icon (black logo, rendered white by the CSS).

props.name: name
props.description: Smart banner: app name, e.g. "dot.Bible". Promo: brand line, e.g. "dot.Bible · free".

props.name: subtitle
props.description: Smart banner: sub-line, e.g. "Read offline in 500+ languages".

props.name: href
props.description: Smart banner: URL of the Open button. Strip: URL of the "Get the app" link.

props.name: actionLabel
props.description: Smart banner: label of the Open button, e.g. "Open". Strip: label of the link, e.g. "Get the app".

props.name: regionLabel
props.description: Smart banner: accessible name of the region.

props.name: dismissLabel
props.description: Smart banner: accessible name of the dismiss button.

props.name: onDismiss
props.description: Smart banner: called when the reader dismisses the banner. Remember the choice for the visit.

props.name: heading
props.description: Promo: heading, e.g. "Take the Bible with you, even offline."

props.name: description
props.description: Promo: one or two sentences under the heading.

props.name: qr
props.description: Promo: QR code element (`<svg>`). Hidden on phones by the CSS.

props.name: qrLabel
props.description: Promo: accessible name of the QR.

props.name: storeLabels
props.description: Promo: override store badge text and accessible names.

props.name: imageAlt
props.description: Promo: alt text of the photo (real description, e.g. "A hand holding a phone").

props.name: children
props.description: Strip: the message; wrap the lead in `<b>`. Falls back to `children`.

variants.classes: .card card-lg card-flat mn-promo (two columns; stacks under 768px, QR hidden, photo 220px)

variantNotes: Dismiss `.mn-sb-x`: default (`--gray-600`), hover (`--gray-100` fill, black icon), focus ring.

states.universal: See rules/states.md for the seven required states and their hooks.

rules: The smart banner's Open is the one Horizon Blue button on screen at that moment; the header Give pill stays `.btn-light`.
Always offer dismiss on the smart banner; remember the choice for the visit and do not show it again after dismiss.
Dismiss and Open are at least 44px / 40px tall; the X is a 44px circle.
The promo card uses StoreBadges `.mn-store-sm`, never blue buttons, to install the app. Hide the QR on phones.
The strip's link goes to the app page, so it ends with ↗ and uses `.btn-ghost`.
The app icon is the black logo file rendered white (`filter: brightness(0) invert(1)`).
Use real product facts only: free, offline, 500+ languages.

accessibility: The smart banner is a named region (`aria-label="Get the dot.Bible app"`).
Dismiss has `aria-label="Dismiss"`; after dismissing, move focus to the page's first heading or skip link.
App tile images are decorative (`alt=""`); the name beside them carries meaning.
Promo photo has real alt text ("A hand holding a phone").
Do not animate the banner in once the page has been read; it renders on load only.
